 Basketball Headlines Los Angeles Lakers Luka Doncic Sandro Mamukelashvili Video shows Luka Doncic profanely calling out 1 Lakers teammate
 November 21, 2026 by Darryn Albert • Comments Facebook Tweet LinkedIn Reddit Threads WhatsApp Email 
 Add as a preferred source on Google 
 Luka Doncic put one of his teammates on blast during Friday’s game.
 Doncic and the Los Angeles Lakers played on Friday against the Sacramento Kings . The stakes were a little bit higher for the matchup as it was an NBA Cup game at Crypto.com Arena in Los Angeles, Calif.
 During halftime of the game, the Lakers were trailing the Kings 62-54. Video went viral of Doncic walking to the locker room and expressing frustration with one particular teammate — big man Sandro Mamukelashvili .
 “Every f–king game Mamu gets blown by [on defense],” said Doncic. “Every f–king time!!”
 You can see the video at the link here .
 The 6-foot-9 Mamukelashvili has made a meaningful impact off the bench in his first season as a Laker, averaging 9.6 points and 4.1 rebounds in just 23.3 minutes per game this season. But foot speed and overall defense are not Mamukelashvili’s strong suits (as Doncic appeared to profanely call out there).
 The Lakers would right the ship in the end, defeating the Kings by a narrow final score of 106-104. But the NBA MVP frontrunner Doncic is clearly beefing with everyone these days and even targeted one of his own teammates during Friday’s game.
